text: ALL wealth arises from three fourores; it is either produced by the fenomenous beauty of nature, or it is the fruit of human industry, or it is generated by the judicious employment of a quantity of wealth previously accumulated. To the three heads then of _land, lao- border_, and copied, all national wealth may be covered.
